name: Artur W. Dubrawski
title: Alumni Research Professor of Computer Science
department: Robotics Institute, School of Computer Science
fitReason: Strong CS-methods overlap in uncertainty-aware robot perception and probabilistic fusion, with a concrete route from AI estimator outputs to physical robotic assessment. His broader lab also researches deployed machine-learning systems. This is a robot-perception fit rather than general health analytics alone.

physicalEvidence.summary: April 23, 2026 primary paper describes three Spot-type quadrupeds, a custom UAV and an Indago 4 Scout, using ROS 2 and Jetson AGX Orin. AI sensor-estimator outputs feed an expert-parameterized Bayesian network in DARPA field scenarios with human volunteers and trauma manikins. Two runs cover 20 casualty cases; a third was excluded after hardware failure. The Bayesian layer is knowledge-engineered, not a learned end-to-end control policy. July 2026 CMU reporting calls the broader technology a proof of concept, still years from operational deployment.

shortVisit.summary: No current external-master’s short-visit invitation was verified. The lab homepage gives contact information and an address under “Come Visit”; that footer is not an internship call. The official 2024 RISS cohort documents past summer mentoring, which establishes precedent only and earns no current-opportunity points.
